name: Labeling keeps up
says: labeling what arrived adds no wait the person can feel to opening the Prism

measures.says: milliseconds to read, take apart, learn from and label 100 items, from a cold start over ten copies of the specifications' mail and calendar examples, as on a machine that does the pace work in the pace time; the middle of three cold starts

pace.work: each of those items written as JSON, read back and searched for its words of four letters or more, forty times over, timed in the same process straight after the labeling
